We already have a complete Game Design Document (GDD) containing all technical specifications, workflows, and the artistic vision, ready for implementation. Monetization: Mandatory integration of Google Play Billing (in-app purchases for premium currency and bundles) and rewarded ads (restricted exclusively to a side-billboard; no intrusive interstitial ads). Visual Style / Animation: The game does not require complex action animations or heavy, arcade-style physics. Instead, it relies on clean menus, intuitive UI/UX, static backgrounds, and avatars/models featuring subtle, specific movements on screen. Mandatory Technical Skills and Requirements: Development and Engine: Solid experience with Unity 3D and the C# programming language. Platform: Development focused on and optimized for Android. Backend and Security: Proven knowledge of Node.js, database management (PostgreSQL / SQL), and API architecture for secure management of the official in-game time (anti-cheat) and payment validation (Google Play Billing). Other Skills: Video game development. We are looking for a serious professional with demonstrable experience who knows how to work closely on a project with high visual demands. We look forward to receiving your proposals!

Please share: 1. Recommended Tech Stack (e.g., Node.js/Python, Redis, Playwright, Proxy APIs, Mailwizz API integration any other open source tool). 2. Scenario Stakeholders write asking for KPIs, month-over-month variances, or other numeric summaries stored in a Google Sheet (CSV or a small SQL table is fine, too). The system must: • detect the intent of the message, • locate and calculate the right figures, • draft a human-sounding answer that inserts those numbers, and • push the reply through Gmail or Outlook via API.
